name: lookup_structure_by_id
description: Retrieve structural information for a specific molecular structure using its unique identifier. Use this tool when you have a known structure ID (e.g., a PDB ID) and need detailed information about the structure. Do NOT use this tool for searching structures by keywords or other criteria; for that, use 'search_structures_by_query'.

parameters.name: structure_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the structure, typically a 4-character PDB ID (e.g., '1A2B'). Must be a valid structure ID; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_metadata
parameters.description: Whether to include additional metadata about the structure (e.g., authors, publication details). Set to false to reduce response size if only structural data is needed. Defaults to true.

structure_data.description: Detailed structural information, including coordinates, bonds, and angles.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the structure, only present if include_metadata=true.

return_schema.description: Object containing the structure ID, structural data, and optional metadata.
